content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Lemon Squeezy provides a user-friendly interface for selling digital products, but it is not accessible in many regions due to geographic restrictions. Stripe, on the other hand, operates in only 46 out of 195 countries, leaving numerous creators without a viable payment solution. PayPal, while more widely available, has a history of account suspensions that can leave users without access to their funds for up to 180 days. The lack of option diversity means that many digital creators must rely on workarounds, which can be unreliable and cumbersome in the long run.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

When it comes to restricted countries, platforms like Stripe and PayPal often exclude entire regions from their services. This exclusion creates a significant barrier for creators who want to sell digital products. Lemon Squeezy's policies are similarly restrictive, leaving many creators with limited choices. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as COREMERCH, provides a permanent structural alternative. By leveraging tools like Cloudflare and NOWPayments, creators can circumvent these restrictions, allowing them seamless access to market their products without relying on platforms that limit their reach.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing speed is crucial for digital creators, and platforms like Stripe and PayPal often fail in this regard, particularly in restricted countries. Stripe’s processing can take longer due to compliance checks and geographic restrictions, while PayPal can hold funds for an extended period, impacting cash flow. Lemon Squeezy has its own set of fees that can cut into profits. In contrast, COREMERCH solutions utilize NOWPayments, which charges only a 0.5% fee with automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This efficiency means creators receive their payments faster and without the hidden costs associated with traditional platforms.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure means true ownership and autonomy.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a critical factor for digital creators, yet traditional platforms often retain rights or control over accounts. Lemon Squeezy, Stripe, and PayPal do not provide the level of ownership that creators need. With COREMERCH's sovereign commerce stack, creators retain full ownership of their digital assets after deployment. This infrastructure ensures that creators can automate their sales processes, from payment verification to file delivery, without depending on third-party platforms that may impose restrictions or fees.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs as a digital creator. If you're located in a restricted country, relying on platforms like Stripe or PayPal may not be feasible. Instead, consider investing in a sovereign commerce solution like COREMERCH, where you can deploy your digital store using the Complete Builder Kit. This kit provides all the necessary blueprints and templates to establish an independent, scalable online store. For creators who need instant access and full ownership, this architecture is the clear winner.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Avoid payment delays and restrictions with decentralized payment methods.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
